title: Every package reference file link-resolves in-package
prompt: Evaluator-added. The candidate's own DP-C-001 link-checks only SKILL.md and references/sources.md. These two reference files are the ones carrying substantive conditional detail and are not link-checked by any authored case.

expectations.summary: All local Markdown destinations in references/recording-rules.md and references/evidence-and-scope.md resolve inside the package.

title: Every evals files[] entry exists in the package
prompt: Evaluator-added. evals.json and cases.jsonl both declare files[] fixture paths resolving relative to the evals directory. No authored case checks that they exist.

expectations.summary: Each distinct files[] entry named by evals.json or cases.jsonl resolves to a file under evals/.

title: No Codex-only or unshipped provider artifact in a Claude package
prompt: Evaluator-added provider-correctness observation. agents/openai.yaml is Codex subagent metadata and has no place in a Claude plugin skill; scripts/ and hooks/ are absent from this package by design and their absence is asserted so a later addition is visible.

expectations.summary: agents/openai.yaml, scripts/ and hooks/ are absent from the Claude source package.

title: Output templates still carry their placeholders and required sections
prompt: Evaluator-added. The two shipped assets are blank source templates; the packaged copies must still hold the placeholders that make a filled result identifiable as a draft, and must carry the boundary section the specification requires.

expectations.summary: assets/product-brief.md holds unfilled placeholders in its required fields (a blank template is expected to MISMATCH required_report_fields; that MISMATCH is the confirming observation, not a defect), and its MVP-boundary field names are present.

title: Frontmatter carries exactly the two contract-required fields
prompt: Evaluator-added. The authoring contract fixes Claude frontmatter at name and description. The authored DP-C-001 A2 establishes both are populated but not that nothing else is present; this records the read for a human check.

expectations.summary: name and description are populated scalars and the frontmatter parses under the restricted reader without INDETERMINATE.
